help:
EaC — Experience as Code

EaC is a deterministic creative runtime.

If this is your first time using EaC:

1. Run `eac guide`
2. Inspect the project with `eac inspect`
3. Build one scene at a time
4. Start with static geometry
5. Add timed motion
6. Run `eac check`
7. Fix all errors
8. Preview
9. Render

Do not attempt to invent EaC APIs.

If you are unsure which API to use:
  eac docs search "<what you want to do>"

For an API:
  eac docs <api>

To format a project after a check diagnostic:
  eac format <project>

For a machine-readable node tree, writers, assets, and validation summary:
  eac inspect --json
guide:
HOW TO BUILD WITH EAC

Phase 1 — Understand
- Read the task
- Determine canvas size
- Determine duration

Phase 2 — Structure
- Create scenes
- Use groups for local parent/child transforms
- Identify Rect / Circle / Text / Path / Image nodes

Phase 3 — Static Composition
- Place Rect / Circle / Text / Path
- Use project-relative assets only
- Add normalized color and styling
- Run eac check

Phase 4 — Motion
- Add one motion group at a time
- Use sequence / parallel / stagger for reusable plans
- Use followPath for one deterministic position writer
- Prefer existing primitives
- Never invent API names
- Use eac docs search when uncertain

Phase 5 — Validate
- Run eac check
- Read the full diagnostic
- Fix the cause, not only the symptom

Optional Audio
- Use frozen project-relative WAV assets
- HTML preview is silent; eac render muxes checked audio into MP4

Phase 6 — Preview
- Preview before rendering
- Seek, step frames, and change playback speed without changing the experience

Phase 7 — Render
- Render only after eac check passes

Do not generate the entire experience in one pass.

apiDocs.name: experience
apiDocs.summary: Creates an Experience builder with canvas, duration, and FPS.
apiDocs.signature: experience({ name, width, height, duration, fps? })
apiDocs.example: experience({ name: "demo", width: px(1280), height: px(720), duration: sec(5) })

apiDocs.name: scene
apiDocs.summary: Adds a scene with a global start and duration.

apiDocs.name: group
apiDocs.summary: Creates a transformable parent whose children keep local coordinates.
apiDocs.signature: scene.group(id, { position?, rotation?, scale?, opacity?, depth? })
apiDocs.example: const card = scene.group("card", { position: { x: px(200), y: px(300) } }); card.rect("body", { position: { x: px(0), y: px(0) }, ... })

apiDocs.name: rect
apiDocs.summary: Creates a rectangle with a centered position.
apiDocs.example: scene.rect("card", { position: { x: px(200), y: px(100) }, width: px(240), height: px(120), fill: "#222" })

apiDocs.name: circle
apiDocs.summary: Creates a circle with a centered position.
apiDocs.example: scene.circle("dot", { position: { x: px(50), y: px(50) }, radius: px(12), fill: "red" })

apiDocs.name: text
apiDocs.summary: Creates text using approximate bounds for checking.
apiDocs.signature: scene.text(id, text, { position, fontSize, fill, width? })
apiDocs.example: scene.text("title", "Hello", { position: { x: px(80), y: px(100) }, fontSize: px(48), fill: "white" })

apiDocs.name: path
apiDocs.summary: Creates a polyline or closed polygon from points.
apiDocs.signature: scene.path(id, points, { position, closed?, strokeWidth?, fill, stroke? })
apiDocs.example: scene.path("line", [{ x: px(0), y: px(0) }, { x: px(100), y: px(50) }], { position: { x: px(10), y: px(10) }, fill: "none", stroke: "white" })

apiDocs.name: moveTo
apiDocs.summary: Moves position from its value at `at` to a target position.
apiDocs.example: dot.moveTo({ x: px(400), y: px(200) }, { at: sec(1), duration: sec(2) })

apiDocs.name: moveBy
apiDocs.summary: Moves by an offset from the position evaluated at `at`.
apiDocs.example: dot.moveBy({ x: px(120), y: px(-20) }, { at: sec(1), duration: sec(0.8) })

apiDocs.name: bezier
apiDocs.summary: Uses a cubic Bézier trajectory for moveTo.
apiDocs.example: dot.moveTo(target, { at: sec(0), duration: sec(2), trajectory: { kind: "bezier", control1, control2 } })

apiDocs.name: cycloid
apiDocs.summary: Uses a deterministic cycloid trajectory for moveTo.
apiDocs.example: dot.moveTo(target, { at: sec(0), duration: sec(2), trajectory: { kind: "cycloid", radius: px(30) } })

apiDocs.name: followPath
apiDocs.summary: Moves position along one absolute deterministic path writer.
apiDocs.example: dot.followPath(trajectory.orbit({ center, radius: px(80) }), { at: sec(1), duration: sec(2) })

apiDocs.name: ellipse
apiDocs.summary: Creates an absolute elliptical arc with explicit center, radii, angles, and rotation.
apiDocs.signature: trajectory.ellipse({ center, radiusX, radiusY, rotation?, startAngle?, endAngle? })
apiDocs.example: trajectory.ellipse({ center, radiusX: px(120), radiusY: px(60), startAngle: deg(0), endAngle: deg(180) })

apiDocs.name: orbit
apiDocs.summary: Creates a circular absolute orbit with a start angle and positive turn count.

apiDocs.name: spiral
apiDocs.summary: Creates an absolute spiral by interpolating radius and angle.
apiDocs.signature: trajectory.spiral({ center, startRadius, endRadius, turns?, startAngle? })
apiDocs.example: trajectory.spiral({ center, startRadius: px(10), endRadius: px(120), turns: 2 })

apiDocs.name: wave
apiDocs.summary: Creates a sine wave perpendicular to a non-degenerate start/end baseline.
apiDocs.signature: trajectory.wave({ start, end, amplitude, cycles?, phase? })
apiDocs.example: trajectory.wave({ start, end, amplitude: px(24), cycles: 3 })

apiDocs.name: rotateTo
apiDocs.summary: Rotates from the angle at `at` to a target angle.

apiDocs.name: rotateBy
apiDocs.summary: Rotates by an angle from the rotation evaluated at `at`.

apiDocs.name: scaleTo
apiDocs.summary: Scales uniformly or per axis to an absolute target.
apiDocs.signature: object.scaleTo(number | { x, y }, { at, duration, easing? })

apiDocs.name: scaleBy
apiDocs.summary: Adds a scale delta to the scale evaluated at `at`.
apiDocs.signature: object.scaleBy(number | { x, y }, { at, duration, easing? })

apiDocs.name: fadeTo
apiDocs.summary: Interpolates opacity to a value from 0 to 1.

apiDocs.name: depthTo
apiDocs.summary: Moves an object along the 2.5D depth axis.

apiDocs.name: depthBy
apiDocs.summary: Moves by a depth offset from the depth evaluated at `at`.

apiDocs.name: easing
apiDocs.summary: Provides deterministic linear, ease-in/out, and cubic Bézier timing curves.
apiDocs.signature: easing.linear | easing.easeIn | easing.easeOut | easing.easeInOut | easing.cubicBezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)
apiDocs.example: dot.moveTo(target, { at: sec(1), duration: sec(0.8), easing: easing.easeOut })

apiDocs.name: motion
apiDocs.summary: Creates an immutable atomic MotionPlan without assigning a runtime start time.
apiDocs.signature: motion.moveTo(node, target, { duration, easing? }) and matching property helpers
apiDocs.example: const enter = motion.fadeTo(title, opacity(1), { duration: sec(0.4) })

apiDocs.name: sequence
apiDocs.summary: Composes MotionPlans with deterministic cumulative offsets.

apiDocs.name: parallel
apiDocs.summary: Composes MotionPlans at one shared start and uses the longest duration.

apiDocs.name: delay
apiDocs.summary: Creates empty plan time or shifts a MotionPlan by a fixed duration.

apiDocs.name: stagger
apiDocs.summary: Offsets one plan per stable input index by a fixed interval.
apiDocs.example: schedule(stagger(dots, sec(0.1), (dot) => motion.fadeTo(dot, opacity(1), { duration: sec(0.3) })))

apiDocs.name: schedule
apiDocs.summary: Lowers a MotionPlan at an explicit time into ordinary checked TimedProperty writes.

apiDocs.name: presets
apiDocs.summary: Provides small fadeIn, fadeOut, popIn, and riseIn plans built from public primitives.

apiDocs.name: color
apiDocs.summary: Creates normalized sRGB colors and animates fill with deterministic channel interpolation.
apiDocs.signature: rgb(r, g, b) | rgba(r, g, b, a) | hex(value); object.colorTo(color, options)

apiDocs.name: styling
apiDocs.summary: Configures stroke, corner radius, blur, shadow, and deterministic text attributes.
apiDocs.signature: { stroke, strokeWidth, cornerRadius, blur, shadow, fontFamily, fontWeight, textAlign, letterSpacing }

apiDocs.name: bringForward
apiDocs.summary: Semantic depthTo primitive that brings an object forward.
apiDocs.example: dot.bringForward({ at: sec(1), duration: sec(2), to: depth(100) })

apiDocs.name: image
apiDocs.summary: Creates an image from a safe project-relative PNG, JPEG, or SVG asset.
apiDocs.signature: scene.image(id, { src, position, width, height, fit? })
apiDocs.example: scene.image("photo", { src: "assets/photo.png", position, width: px(320), height: px(180), fit: "cover" })

apiDocs.name: asset
apiDocs.summary: Creates a validated local asset reference; remote and traversing paths are rejected.

apiDocs.name: trajectory
apiDocs.summary: Creates deterministic paths for followPath or trajectory options for moveTo.

apiDocs.name: colorTo
apiDocs.summary: Animates fill color using deterministic normalized sRGB channel interpolation.

apiDocs.name: strokeColorTo
apiDocs.summary: Animates stroke color without replacing the fill writer.

apiDocs.name: blurTo
apiDocs.summary: Animates a non-negative SVG-rendered blur radius.

apiDocs.name: audio
apiDocs.summary: Schedules a deterministic local WAV clip for full MP4 rendering.
apiDocs.signature: scene.audio(path, { id?, at?, duration?, trim?, volume?, fadeIn?, fadeOut? })
apiDocs.example: scene.audio("assets/click.wav", { at: sec(1.2), volume: 0.8, fadeOut: sec(0.1) })

apiDocs.name: units
apiDocs.summary: Creates explicit length, time, angle, opacity, and depth values.
apiDocs.signature: px(value) | sec(value) | ms(value) | deg(value) | rad(value) | opacity(value) | depth(value)
apiDocs.example: { x: px(100), at: sec(1), rotation: deg(45), opacity: opacity(0.8) }

apiDocs.name: inspect
apiDocs.summary: Prints the node tree, normalized writers, assets, counts, and validation summary.

apiDocs.name: check
apiDocs.summary: Runs static rules and the deterministic frame harness with actionable diagnostics.

apiDocs.name: preview
apiDocs.summary: Writes an interactive HTML timeline with seek, stepping, time, and playback speed.
